name: sopilot
description: SOPilot turns messy business SOPs into structured AI agent workflow specs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @sopilot/cli build && pnpm --filter @sopilot/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @sopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @sopilot/core lint && pnpm --filter @sopilot/cli lint && pnpm --filter @sopilot/web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @sopilot/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @sopilot/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @sopilot/web typecheck
scripts.generate:examples: pnpm --filter @sopilot/core build && tsx packages/cli/src/index.ts generate-all --out examples/generated
